ref.title: Measures and temperatures
ref.intro: Temperatures, ratios, times and cuts from every lesson in one place. Tap a row to open its lesson.
ref.tempsNote: Measure in the thickest part, not touching bone. Pull it 3–5°C early: meat keeps cooking while it rests.
ref.restText: Steak 5 min, roast 10–15 min, loosely covered with foil.
ref.zoneText: Between 5°C and 60°C bacteria multiply fastest. Cool cooked food and refrigerate it within 2 hours.
landing.title: Learn to cook. And to think like a chef.
landing.sub: A step-by-step cooking school from a chef with 16 years in professional kitchens. No videos, no filler: one step, an exact measure and a sign that tells you it is done.
landing.how1d: One action, up to 15 words. The phone sits by the board and the screen stays on.
landing.how2d: 5 mm, 74°C, 8 min. Never "a little" or "medium heat".
landing.how3d: A sign you can see, hear or feel. You confirm it instead of guessing.
landing.how4d: Every lesson ends with a "why". After grade 1 you cook without a recipe.
landing.chefText: This course is written the way cooking is learned in a real kitchen: in order, with a reason for every step and none of the shortcuts that cost you later.
landing.mcText: Recipes from the lessons lead into MacroChef, with macros and allergens. Learn to cook it, then see what you eat.
exam.label: Final exam
exam.intro: You open the fridge and find 10 ingredients. Plan a meal, write down three decisions, cook it and check yourself. No recipe.
exam.rules1: One plate: a protein, a side and vegetables.
exam.rules2: You do not have to use everything in the basket.
exam.rules3: Salt, pepper, oil and flour are always there.
exam.planIntro: Write a sentence or two for each decision. This is a cook's thinking, not a recipe.
exam.cookIntro: While you cook, tick each habit as you do it.
exam.doneText: You cooked a meal without a recipe and you know why you did every step.
exam.macro: Enter this meal in MacroChef as a recipe and see the macros of your own dish.
